contract_selection: fixed ordered design grid in task context
noise: independent additive Gaussian forward-unit quote errors, one sd per contract, no clipping
prior: independent uniforms in explicit parameter_names order; curve context from context_prior
rng: PCG64; SeedSequence(option tag, root, task digest words, split, ID, purpose); purposes 0 prior, 1 pricing, 2 quotes, 3 curve context

roles.context: known contracts, forward units and per-contract quote sigma; stored in configuration
roles.context_parameters: auxiliary draws behind the curve (sigma0 and the slope or exponent); never conditioning
roles.context_values: known per-example forward-variance levels on the knot intervals; conditioning
roles.example_id: auxiliary split-qualified surface identity; augmentations must keep base grouping
roles.parameters: ordered synthetic training targets only; never observed conditioning
roles.pricing_covariance: auxiliary covariance of MC price MEANS; zero for Fourier
roles.pricing_paths: auxiliary Monte Carlo paths used per maturity block
roles.pricing_standard_errors: auxiliary MC standard errors (zero for deterministic Fourier)
roles.reference_prices: auxiliary numerical expectation estimates, not exact market truth
roles.refinement_difference: auxiliary refined-minus-base Fourier estimate; MC zeros mean not calculated
